name: Bondada Engineering Ltd
title: Bondada Engineering Ltd - 543971 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue ~INR2,843 crore with order book INR7,147 crore and 1.5 GW commissioning target; management guides 60-70% FY27 growth but gives no capacity-discipline signal and leans on a new 120-130 crore plant plus data-centre and defence diversification.

capex.quote: the Capex would be around INR120 crores to INR130 crores.

triggers.label: FY27 growth 60-70% guided
triggers.quote: 60% to 70% can be expected for this year.

triggers.label: Q4 margin dip from low-margin billing and cable/steel costs
triggers.quote: we have booked some low margin projects billing in this fourth quarter

triggers.label: Receivables ~87 days, >1yr outstandings
triggers.quote: that average aging is coming to 87 days.

triggers.label: New INR120-130 cr integrated plant
triggers.quote: this plant construction will start anytime in the second quarter of this financial year.

guidance.quote: 60% to 70% can be expected for this year.
EBITDA margins for this year will remain same or maybe we will have a little improved margins of by about 20, 30 basis points yes.
this year we are targeting almost a kind of one and a half gigawatt of projects to get commissioned.

red_flags.label: Segment data inconsistency: services revenue reported drop, management disputes
Current liabilities up ~INR330 cr via TReDS and customer advances
red_flags.quote: it got shot up from INR 170 crore to INR 500 crores.

red_flags.label: Receivables ~INR760-790 cr, some outstanding over one year
red_flags.quote: there are few, few outstandings which is more than one year.

red_flags.label: Dependence on AP 2 GW IPP with equity needs and dilution question
red_flags.quote: we can raise the equity which is required for the IPP 2 gigawatt.

evasions.quote: We may not able to tell that actually what is the cost of per megawatt-hour in this public forum.
Actually we are not risen to that.
